paragraphs: Chapter 422
Episode 122. Emperor (2)
'...Show me some confidence.'
A silent laugh slipped through his lips.
He had expected a proposal for something like an alliance under the pretext of a reward.
With the whole world knowing that the imperial family is stabbing Hailan in the back, it was obvious that he was called separately to receive a reward.
"To swallow Runecandle and, furthermore, to have the power to stand against Ziephel."
"Isn't it an attractive story?"
Jin stared at the emperor's shining eyes for a moment.
'He is the emperor of the empire after all, with quite a firm gaze.'
It wasn't easy to read what was behind those eyes.
"Do you know?"
"What are you talking about?"
"Not long ago, at the Sword Garden, I demonstrated my abilities. That day, I declared that I would become a lord."

"How could I not know? That day, your majestic display was given the names 'Return of the Demonic Sword' and 'Declaration of Lordship' by the onlookers. For a while, the entire Biment region was filled with songs about you sung by troubadours. I, too, enjoyed the song and ordered the imperial orchestra to play it."
"I'm embarrassed to hear such a thing happened. Anyway, the reason I made the declaration in front of everyone was none other than this. I already..."
Meaning, I already have the power to become a lord.
As Jin continued, the emperor blinked his eyes softly.

"I heard that most of the execution knights and black knights, as well as the Council of Elders, have already fallen into the hands of the 2nd Riders. On the other hand, isn't your influence somewhat weak?"
At those words, Jin couldn't help but laugh again.
"So that's how I look to outsiders."
Weak.
There was a time when it was true. When Jin was in Storm Castle and had only one ally, Gilli.
However, ever since awakening Murakan in the glass tube of Storm Castle's secret underground, Jin's power had never been weak in absolute terms.
Although Murakan had lost some power, given the opportunity to recover, he could be one of the strongest beings at any time.

Following Murakan, Luna, the comrades of Tichan Free City, the Abyss, the Nameless King Tribe of Lafrarosa, the Holy Kingdom, Misha, the Asmodians of Solderet, the Little Dwarves, the Wantaromo Forest, Hailan's Ron and Dante.

In addition, within Runecandle, there were Yona and some of the elders, knights who showed favor to Jin after the declaration of lordship, and Beradin, who was in a sane state. There were also quite a few forces that could be considered temporary allies.
Jin's current power is one of the top in the world, and its potential for expansion is tremendous.
But hearing that it was weak, he couldn't help but find it amusing.
"You have formed such a good external image. I know that the power you are hiding is enormous."
"I'm not in desperate need of the Emperor's help."
"However, I don't know about the power of Runecandle's 2nd generation... I thought you knew well about the power of Ziephel."
"Is there anyone in the world who doesn't know the power they have?"
"It is they who are overwhelming the entire world with just the tip of the iceberg. I asked if you have ever seen beneath Ziephel's surface. If so..."
The emperor paused for a moment.
And then shivered, recalling the 'real power' of Ziephel that he had glimpsed once. A trembling that was hard to distinguish between chills and fear.
"You wouldn't be able to say that you're not desperate to meet anyone."
"It seems that the Emperor is afraid of Ziephel."
"Aren't you afraid of them?"
"You said you thought you knew me a little bit earlier, but now you're talking nonsense."
"The first lord of Runecandle, Temar Runecandle."
Suddenly, the emperor mentioned that name. Jin maintained a calm expression.
- Who is it? The other forces looking for Temar's tomb.
- Who do you think it is?
- Ziephel.
- Correct! But that's not all.
- The Biment Imperial Family is also looking for the tomb of the first lord of Runecandle. Your whereabouts have been exposed to them once.
The conversation Marzella and Jin had when Velakt visited Rosa some time ago.
Jin first learned about the fact that forces other than Runecandle and Ziephel were looking for Temar's tomb. Even the fact that Biment wanted Temar's corpse.
'I didn't expect him to bring up Temar first.'
Jin met the emperor's gaze and waited for his next words.
"According to the records, he had the strongest power in history. No one at that time could dare to handle Temar Runecandle..."
"Which record is that?"
"Even he couldn't overcome the wall called Ziephel, but can you alone face that evil?"
"I asked you where you found that record."
"I'll show you if you become my man."
Suddenly, a powerful energy erupted from Jin like an erupting volcano. Cracks appeared on the floor where he stood, and the momentarily heavy air settled down.
Even if this was the emperor's court, there was no reason to suppress his anger after hearing such words.
Temar was an ancestor of Runecandle, and Biment dared not mention the records that even Runecandle couldn't possess.
At the moment when my bodyguards and the royal guards were about to move, the emperor raised his hand to stop them. Jin did not release any more energy.
"Since the Emperor has restrained the swords, I will consider the discourtesy I just committed as if it never happened."
Jin spoke in a calm voice. The Biment's 'Mines' encountered in the Wantaralmo Forest came to mind, and something hot surged in his chest.
Biment is trying to complete the Mine using Temar's corpse.
Jin had suspected Biment since the Wantaralmo Forest.
That suspicion became closer to certainty through today's meeting with the emperor, and once confirmed, it would not be satisfying enough to destroy the royal family.
"And I will warn you just once, Emperor. If you ever obtain the body of the first lord and make a vulgar puppet... Biment's thousands of years of history will all turn to bubbles."
"Haha, talking to you is as thrilling as walking on a tightrope."
"No matter when or where, whenever the Emperor finds a clue about the tomb of the first lord of Runecandle, you must report to Runecandle."
The emperor did not show anger or discomfort no matter what Jin said.
"I'll think about that after you become the king of swordsmen."
It seemed like a light remark, but his intention was clear.
You probably can't become a lord without my help, the emperor was saying that.
"Anyway, right now, it's impossible for me to be your ally. However, I have already decided to reward you..."
The emperor, who had spoken up to that point, seemed to have thought of something and clapped his hands.
"Hyran. How about you take the entire family? It was for rewarding you for saving Hyran in the first place."
"You speak as if you can handle Hyran at will."
"Of course. There is nothing I can't do in Biment."
"Taking a family requires loyalty first. Even if the emperor grants me intangible sovereignty, Ron and Dante swearing loyalty to me? It's laughable."
"You're making something simple complicated. Do you really think there's no way?"
"Pressuring Ron by taking Dante hostage?"
"Not bad, but there are a few more options."
"When the terror occurred, I did my best to minimize the damage to Hyran. Do you think I would stab Hyran in the back like the royal family?"
"Why?"
It was the first time during the conversation that the emperor had shown such intense emotion.
The emperor looked puzzled. He couldn't understand at all why Jin was trying to protect Hyran.

"When I heard that you were active in Sword Emperor City, I was very curious. From Runecandle's perspective, it was a terrorist attack that could bring many benefits, but I couldn't think of a proper reason why you protected Hyran. What is it?"
"There's no need for a grand reason to help a friend."
"...What, a friend?"
The emperor abruptly stood up, shouting as if it was absurd.
"You're saying you'd give up such a benefit for such a trivial reason!?"
In an extremely disappointed tone, Jin merely shrugged at his intense reaction.
"Is there a problem?"
The emperor, who soon sat back down, sighed.
"The excitement and chills I felt while talking to you are cooling down. I didn't expect you to say something so wishy-washy..."
"Is it less interesting?"
"If you continue like this, it will be difficult for you to survive in future battles."
"I have always survived this way."
Although the emperor's eyes now showed disbelief, he soon regained a calm expression and lowered his head.
"Look here."
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
"Give Jin Runecandle a gold crown."
At those words, Jin briefly bowed and turned around.
"Sir Jin."
As he began to walk away to leave the royal chamber, the emperor called out to Jin and said,
"From today, the possibility of you and me becoming allies is almost gone. Be sure to recognize that fact, and when you meet me next time... be more prepared."
After talking with Jin, the emperor concluded that there was no need to join forces with Runecandle when he was not walking on a line like now but definitely belonged to one side.
Until the time when he could see new possibilities from another Runecandle other than Jin, there was absolutely no need.
That meant there would be no such treatment after today.
"Ah, I remembered something I forgot to mention. Sir Ron asked me to tell the Emperor. It would be good to make wise choices in various ways."
The emperor didn't respond, and Jin finished his sentence as he left the royal chamber.
"In other words, it's a suggestion to choose your side wisely. So that you won't regret it."
After Jin left the royal chamber, the emperor stared at the place where his figure had been for a while.
